contentMap.productCategory: AI image generation and AI video generation
contentMap.targetAudience: Professionals and enterprises creating high-quality visual content, including creative directors, video producers, and art directors

hero.headline: Create High-Quality AI Images & Videos with ByteDance Generative Models
hero.subheadline: Unlock the power of next-generation generative AI with Seedream 4.5 (Image Generation) and Seedance 1.5 Pro (Video Generation) - advanced foundation models developed by ByteDance for high-quality visual content creation.
hero.supportingLine: From text prompts, images, or scripts, generate professional visuals and videos with powerful multimodal AI systems.

productSections.name: Seedream 4.5
productSections.label: AI Image Generation
productSections.headline: AI Image Generation with Seedream 4.5
productSections.description: Seedream 4.5 is a high-performance multimodal image generation system designed to produce high-resolution, high-fidelity images from text prompts and visual inputs. The model unifies text-to-image synthesis, image editing, and multi-image composition within a single framework.

features.title: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance
features.description: From accurate text rendering to consistent image editing and multi-image composition, Seedream 4.5 powers high-quality, professional visual creation with superior precision and control.

features.title: Advanced Text–Image Alignment
features.description: Accurately translates prompts into visuals with improved semantic understanding.

features.title: High-Resolution Output
features.description: Generate native images up to 1K–4K resolution with strong visual fidelity.

features.title: Superior Typographic Rendering
features.description: Optimized for posters, ads, and text-heavy visual designs.

features.title: Multi-Image Composition with Identity Preservation
features.description: Combines multiple inputs while accurately maintaining subject consistency.

features.title: Strong Structural Fidelity
features.description: Maintains composition, layout, and scene structure with high precision.

productSections.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro
productSections.label: AI Video Generation
productSections.headline: AI Video Generation with Seedance 1.5 Pro by Bytedance
productSections.description: Seedance 1.5 Pro is a next-generation generative model designed for native audio-visual generation, enabling synchronized creation of video and sound together. Built on a dual-branch diffusion transformer architecture, the model integrates cross-modal learning to produce coherent visual and audio outputs.

features.title: Key Capabilities of Seedance 1.5 Pro
features.description: Seedance enables professional-grade AI video production with narrative coherence and realistic motion.

features.title: Text-to-Video Generation
features.description: Create videos directly from text prompts.

features.title: Audio-Visual Synchronization
features.description: Generate video and audio simultaneously with strong multimodal alignment.

features.title: Multilingual Lip-Sync
features.description: Supports multilingual and dialect-level lip synchronization.

features.title: Cinematic Camera Control
features.description: Generate videos with dynamic camera movement and cinematic storytelling.

features.title: 10× Faster Inference
features.description: Optimized inference pipeline significantly improves generation speed.

plans.name: Seedream 4.5 (AI Image Generation)
includes: Enhanced typographic rendering for posters, ads & text-heavy designs

plans.name: Seedance 1.5 Pro (AI Video Generation)
includes: Fast inference for quicker video production

testimonials.quote: Seedream allows us to generate high-resolution creative visuals from simple prompts. It has dramatically reduced our design turnaround time.
testimonials.author: Vaishali Saxena

testimonials.quote: Seedance’s ability to generate synchronized audio and video is incredibly powerful for storytelling and branded content.
testimonials.author: Vihaan Pandey

testimonials.quote: The multimodal editing capabilities in Seedream make it easy to refine images with precision.
testimonials.author: Anurag Malhotra

extras: Headline: What Professionals Say About Seedream and Seedance?

referenceMap.heroPattern: Full-width top hero with brand/logo at upper left, large single-column headline treatment, short supporting copy, and a compact bullet-list value proposition stack beneath; visual emphasis comes from typography and dark banner contrast rather than imagery.
referenceMap.sectionRhythm: Hero-first landing page followed by a form/lead-capture block; content is structured in stacked sections with clear vertical separation and minimal lateral complexity. Rhythm favors one primary message per band with strong section boundaries.
referenceMap.cardStyle: Simple functional cards with solid background, subtle border/shadow treatment, and dense content hierarchy; utility-first presentation over decorative styling.
referenceMap.ctaPattern: Primary CTA appears in the hero as a single prominent action; secondary actions are sparse or absent. Additional conversion is handled through a separate form section rather than repeated button clusters.
referenceMap.footerMode: Footer not visible in the provided reference; pattern appears conversion-focused and likely minimal if present.
referenceMap.mediaPattern: Primarily text-led layout with optional banner/carousel treatment; if media is used, it functions as a supporting hero panel rather than a dominant product showcase.
referenceMap.productSectionPattern: Product detail sections use a labeled section header, strong headline, descriptive paragraph, then a feature list or capability bullets. The pattern supports progressive disclosure from overview to specific benefits.
referenceMap.formPattern: Dedicated lead form block separated from the hero, presented as a bordered card with a section title and vertically stacked inputs. Hidden fields suggest tracked intake and qualification. Form acts as the main conversion endpoint.
referenceMap.animationStyle: Carousel-driven motion only; otherwise static and straightforward with no visible micro-interaction system.
componentPatterns: Bullet feature list with icon ticks
designNotes: Use a bold, dark hero band to create instant contrast and hierarchy.
Keep copy concise in the hero and move detailed explanation into later sections.
Prefer bullet-point proof over long paragraphs for benefits.
Use a separate form module instead of embedding complex conversion actions in the hero.
Maintain generous whitespace and simple stacked alignment for enterprise readability.
If media is introduced, keep it secondary and informational rather than immersive.
Avoid decorative complexity; the page communicates trust through structure and clarity.

personality.productType: ai image and video generation platform
personality.buyer: creative directors, video producers, art directors, and enterprise content teams
personality.emotion: awe, control, premium creativity, futuristic confidence
personality.reasoning: This product is clearly AI/generative content software, so it fits the cinematic-ai category. The visual language should feel high-end, experimental, and intelligent, with a deep dark base and violet-cyan style energy. Since the brand colors are strictly defined, the page must use Techjockey’s orange, white, and charcoal palette as the actual identity while keeping the AI experience visually premium and interactive through layered glass-like panels, glowing UI shells, and split content sections for image and video models.

typography.heroFontSizeReason: The hero headline is long, so it needs a smaller, controlled size to preserve hierarchy and avoid awkward wrapping.

colours.colourReason: The brand palette is locked to Techjockey’s orange, white, charcoal, and light grey. Orange becomes the primary CTA and hero color, while charcoal and white create premium contrast. This keeps the page brand-accurate and distinct without introducing an unsupported generic AI gradient palette.

layout.heroReason: The product has strong visual output potential, so a split hero is the best choice. Orange hero background follows the brand rule, while the right side should carry a polished AI-generated visual or abstract model shell to showcase image and video creation immediately.
layout.featureReason: The content naturally breaks into two distinct products: Seedream 4.5 for image generation and Seedance 1.5 Pro for video generation. Alternating sections creates stronger contrast and helps the page feel modular, premium, and easier to scan.
layout.darkSectionFor: the Seedance 1.5 Pro video section, proof bar, and closing CTA band

personality.imageryDirection: Use a polished AI product visual on the hero right side: layered image editor frames, video timeline strips, prompt chips, audio waveform accents, and floating output thumbnails. For Seedream, show high-resolution poster-like outputs and composition controls. For Seedance, show cinematic video frames, subtitle/audio sync bars, and motion-control panels. Keep the visuals abstract and enterprise-grade rather than playful. Use PNG for UI shells, JPEG for large showcase areas, and SVG for icons.
personality.designPersonality: Premium AI content studio with enterprise polish: bold orange brand framing, dark cinematic contrast in secondary sections, floating interface layers, precise cards, and modular feature storytelling that makes the platform feel powerful, credible, and creatively advanced.

designIntent.audience: Professionals and enterprise teams creating high-quality visual content, especially creative directors, video producers, and art directors
designIntent.primaryUserIntent: Evaluate whether Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro can deliver professional-grade AI image and video generation with enough quality, control, and speed to support production workflows

brandDirection.tone: Expert, confident, and technically credible, with a clear enterprise value proposition
brandDirection.visualStyle: Text-led, dark-premium hero with strong contrast, followed by clean light sections and functional cards; minimal decoration, high information clarity

sectionPurpose.purpose: Establish the product family, communicate the two core capabilities immediately, and drive the primary conversion action with a strong above-the-fold CTA
Explain image-generation value through capability-led proof points and show why Seedream 4.5 is suited for professional visual production
Explain video-generation value, emphasizing audio-video synchronization, multilingual lip-sync, and speed for enterprise storytelling use cases
Provide purchase orientation and quote intent without overwhelming the user; frame as commercial next step rather than transactional checkout
Add credibility through role-relevant quotes from creative and production stakeholders

componentNeeds.variantHint: Text-only hero with dark background and strong typographic hierarchy
componentNeeds.notes: No product UI image is provided, so use a centered or text-dominant hero with a strong contrast background. Include headline, subheadline, supporting line, and a single prominent primary CTA. Keep secondary CTA absent or visually suppressed if not provided.
Surface the two product pillars and the multimodal promise as short, scannable bullets beneath the supporting line.

componentNeeds.variantHint: 3-column grid on desktop, single column on mobile
componentNeeds.notes: There are 6 features, so split into a clean card grid with concise hierarchy. Lead with one summary card, then support with capability cards. Maintain technical clarity and avoid decorative icons unless needed for scanability.

componentNeeds.variantHint: 3-column grid on desktop, single column on mobile
componentNeeds.notes: There are 6 features. Present the model overview first, then the core capabilities. Emphasize motion, audio-visual synchronization, lip-sync, and faster inference as enterprise production advantages.

componentNeeds.variantHint: Two stacked or side-by-side quote cards
componentNeeds.notes: Use the provided plan entries only. Since one plan has a visible starting price and the other is quote-based, structure pricing as request-a-quote decision cards rather than a checkout module.
Use 'Get Quote' consistently as the action language for the pricing cards. Keep emphasis on sales-led follow-up, not self-serve purchase.
Render only the valid testimonial entries. Exclude the incomplete 'T' placeholder. Highlight author name, designation, and quote relevance to creative workflows.

layoutStrategy.hero: Use a dark, high-contrast hero with a single strong headline block, short supporting copy, and one prominent CTA. Keep the layout simple and enterprise-oriented, with generous spacing and minimal visual clutter.
layoutStrategy.features: Present Seedream and Seedance as two distinct stacked feature groups or bands, each with its own headline and capability cards. Use a clean 3-column grid on desktop and single-column cards on mobile.
layoutStrategy.proof: Use testimonials after feature explanation and before or alongside pricing if space allows. Keep proof concise and role-specific, with a premium, low-noise card treatment.
layoutStrategy.pricing: Frame pricing as quote-oriented commercial cards rather than a transactional marketplace layout. Make the starting price visible only where provided, and preserve a clear request-quote action.
layoutStrategy.form: No dedicated form section should be designed, since includeForm is false. Use pricing CTAs as the main lead-capture mechanism.

designIntent.tokenProfileHint: Default enterprise-tech profile: Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body, with a dark primary hero, white/light content sections, subtle borders, and accent-led CTAs. Prioritize strong typography, compact card hierarchy, and restrained motion.
designIntent.figmaReadySummary: Design a single-product enterprise landing page with a dark, text-led hero for Seedream 4.5 and Seedance 1.5 Pro, followed by two capability-heavy feature sections, quote-oriented pricing cards, and role-based testimonials. Keep the structure vertical and conversion-focused, avoid form modules, and use clean functional cards with subtle elevation, strong spacing, and early trust-building through clarity rather than heavy ornamentation.

figmaBuildPlan.tokenProfileHint: Use Techjockey default professional tokens with a dark authority hero treatment, white feature cards, light grey trust/pricing/testimonial separators, and accent-led CTAs. Typography should be Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body; apply a text-heavy, enterprise-ready layout with minimal decoration.

sections.variantHint: full-width dark hero, centered text-only treatment with compact value bullets beneath CTA
sections.notes: Use a strong dark hero background with white text per referenceMap.heroPattern and Techjockey hero bgRule. Include brand/logo at upper left, then headline, subheadline, supporting line, and a single primary CTA. Add the banner feature stack as short bullets: AI Image Generation, AI Video Generation with Audio, Multimodal Content Creation, Enterprise-ready AI infrastructure. No secondary CTA because input is empty. Keep the hero dense but controlled, with clear vertical hierarchy.

sections.variantHint: light grey horizontal proof bar with centered pills/dividers
sections.contentSource: contentMap.extras[BANNER FEATURES] + brand trust system placeholders
sections.notes: Trust content is sparse in input, so build a minimal proof bar using the Techjockey trust pattern without inventing customer counts. Use four compact centered pills separated by dividers. Populate with the provided banner feature claims only. Keep background #f8f9fa and use subtle icon treatment if needed.

sections.variantHint: 3-column feature grid with introductory text block spanning full width
sections.notes: Create a full-width section with a section label, headline, and description at top, followed by feature cards. Use 6 feature cards total, so render as a 3-column grid with 2 rows on desktop. Highlight the first feature as a summary card if helpful, but keep all cards within the same system. No hero imagery; rely on text hierarchy and card structure. CTA should sit below the intro copy as a primary text button or compact solid button in the accent color.

sections.variantHint: 3-column feature grid with intro text block; slightly more technical emphasis
sections.notes: Render as a matching product section for visual consistency. Since this section has 6 features, use the same 3-column card grid. Keep the intro copy concise and emphasize synchronized audio-visual generation, multilingual lip-sync, cinematic camera control, and 10x faster inference. No CTA provided in input, so omit the button and let the section read as informational compared to Seedream.

sections.variantHint: 2-card pricing grid with elevated quote-style cards, not a checkout module
sections.notes: Although pricing is partially sparse, it is explicitly supported and should be included. Use two centered pricing cards in a light grey section background. Since only one price is provided and the other is blank, treat this as quote-request pricing rather than transactional pricing. Show included features as checklist items and use a full-width Get Quote CTA on each card. If price is blank, omit numeric emphasis and keep the card quote-led.

sections.variantHint: 3-column testimonial cards with accent left border and star rating row
sections.notes: Use the provided three meaningful testimonials and exclude the malformed 'T' entry. Build 3 cards on desktop with a gold star rating row, italic quote, bold author name, and grey designation line. Keep the section background very light grey or lightly tinted for separation. If company is blank, omit it rather than inventing one.

sections.variantHint: single-column stacked hero with compact bullets and full-width CTA
sections.notes: Stack all hero content vertically. Keep the hero text-led with the same dark treatment and use full-width CTA. Ensure the banner feature stack becomes a short vertical list with compact spacing. Maintain tight line breaks so the long headline remains legible on 390px width. No secondary CTA.

sections.variantHint: stacked compact trust chips with wrapped line breaks
sections.contentSource: contentMap.extras[BANNER FEATURES] + brand trust system placeholders
sections.notes: On mobile, convert the trust strip into wrapped chips or a vertically compact stacked row to prevent crowding. Keep the section shallow and readable. Do not introduce new trust claims beyond the provided banner features.

sections.variantHint: single-column cards with full-width CTA under intro
sections.notes: Convert the 3-column desktop grid into a single-column stacked card list. Keep the intro text above the cards, then place the CTA below it. Preserve card padding and border treatment from the design system, but reduce density slightly for mobile scannability.

sections.variantHint: single-column cards with slightly reduced card density
sections.notes: Mirror the Seedream mobile pattern for consistency. Keep the feature cards stacked and maintain the same typographic system. Since no CTA exists in input, keep the section informational with no button.

sections.variantHint: two stacked pricing cards with full-width Get Quote CTAs
sections.notes: Stack pricing cards vertically on mobile. Treat the section as quote-request pricing rather than transaction pricing. Keep the feature checklist compact and retain the brand trust line under each card where space allows. Remove any shadow intensity if it makes the cards feel heavy on mobile.

Show the three valid testimonials as a vertical stack. Keep the star row, quote, author, and designation hierarchy intact. Omit the malformed entry. Add comfortable spacing between cards for touch readability.

figmaExecutionNotes: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for headings and Inter for body to match Techjockey default professional typography for non-mapped categories.
Apply a dark authority hero with white text; do not use a white hero background.
Keep section sequencing consistent across desktop and mobile: hero, trust, Seedream, Seedance, pricing, testimonials.
Use the design-system feature card pattern with 1px border, 12px radius, and 24px padding; do not invent custom card styling.
Treat pricing as quote-led because one plan price is missing; preserve includes lists and Get Quote CTAs without forcing checkout behavior.
Exclude malformed testimonial content ('T') and only render the three usable testimonials.
On mobile, convert all multi-column grids to single-column stacks and make CTAs full-width.

Right side shows a premium AI studio visual: layered image and video outputs, prompt chips, waveform accents, and editor controls. Keep the composition enterprise-grade and cinematic, with strong contrast and controlled typography.

Present as compact chips or checkmarked statements rather than a logo row.

featurePresentation.primaryFeatureTitle: Advanced Capabilities of Seedream 4.5 by ByteDance

sections.designNote: Create two alternating product blocks with strong visual contrast. Seedream 4.5 should appear first on a light surface with a spotlight feature panel and a supporting feature grid. Seedance 1.5 Pro should follow on a dark section for contrast, using a similar spotlight-plus-grid structure but with video-centric UI cues. This split product storytelling keeps the page modular and makes the difference between image and video generation immediately clear.

This section is not included in the source content, so keep it out of the final layout or use it only if needed as a lightweight brand-assurance block. If shown, present 3 to 4 compact cards on a dark background with orange outlines and short enterprise-focused benefits such as support, procurement simplicity, and deployment confidence.

Use two pricing cards with one emphasized option if needed. Since pricing is sparse and one plan has a starting price while the other is quote-based, treat this as a consultative pricing module rather than a transactional checkout. Keep the Seedance plan visually anchored with the starting price, and make both CTAs consistent as 'Get Quote'.

Because there are four testimonials, use a carousel. Keep the cards minimal, premium, and quote-forward, with the author, role, and company info aligned below each statement. Use one dark quotation mark accent and subtle lift on hover. Ignore the malformed fourth testimonial if it cannot be used cleanly; if retained, it should be sanitized or omitted.

Since no form fields are provided, avoid forcing a full form module. Instead, use a compact conversion band with a headline, a short value reminder, and the single primary CTA 'Generate with AI' or a consult CTA. On the dark background, the card should feel floating, glass-like, and high-conviction.

No news or logo content is provided, so keep this section optional. If shown, convert it into a restrained bottom marquee of product capabilities or ecosystem phrases rather than media logos. Otherwise, omit it to preserve conversion focus.

features.alt: This video presents a calm and peaceful indoor setting, bathed in the warm glow of a sunset. The overall mood is serene and comfortable, with a static activity level. The visual style is pixel art, reminiscent of retro video games, giving it an artistic and nostalgic aesthetic. The room features a bookshelf filled with books, various potted plants, and a comfortable-looking armchair with a cute cat-face pillow. Sunlight streams through a large window, creating bright, warm-toned light patterns on the wooden floor. The color palette is dominated by oranges, yellows, and browns, with touches of green from the plants, creating a high-saturation, inviting atmosphere. tw-object-cover

This image depicts a dynamic, high-energy scene of a modern train traversing diverse weather conditions, representing four distinct seasons. The overall mood is dramatic and visually striking, showcasing the train's resilience. The setting is outdoor, featuring mountainous landscapes in various states: snowy peaks, barren rocks, and hazy desert. The visual style is realistic with a touch of artistic exaggeration to highlight the extreme weather. The emotional tone is powerful and adventurous, emphasizing journey and endurance. The central subject is a sleek, white and blue passenger train. The artistic style is photorealistic, with clear details in the train and surrounding environment. The color characteristics are highly saturated and varied, transitioning from cool blues and whites in the winter storm to warm oranges and yellows in the sunny and dusty desert scenes. The color palette shifts from blue and white to warm orange, yellow, and earthy brown tones. tw-object-cover

This video features a mysterious, sleek gray mannequin-like figure holding up a digital scoreboard at a sports stadium. The mood is calm and slightly surreal, with a bright, outdoor setting under a clear sky. The activity level is static, focusing on the mannequin and the scoreboard. The visual style is modern and realistic, with a subtle artistic touch due to the mannequin's appearance. The emotional tone is neutral, perhaps slightly intriguing. The main subject is the mannequin, dressed in a striped shirt, holding a black digital scoreboard displaying "11:22" in red LED lights. The background shows blurred stadium seating filled with an audience, suggesting a sporting event. The artistic style leans towards photorealism with a high-tech element. The color characteristics are cool tones, primarily grays, blues, and whites, with vibrant red highlights from the scoreboard. The color palette consists mainly of cool grays, light blue, and bright red. tw-object-cover

This video depicts a bright, calm, and spacious indoor setting of a modern minimalist smart home. The atmosphere is peaceful and serene, with a static camera view showcasing the interior design. The visual style is realistic and contemporary, emphasizing clean lines and understated elegance. Key elements include a large living area with a sofa, a sleek kitchen island with a sink, a fireplace with active flames, and a wall-mounted smart display showing various controls. The color characteristics are warm tones, dominated by muted pastels and earthy neutrals like beige, cream, and light wood, with subtle orange highlights from the sun and fireplace. The overall color palette is light and inviting, creating a sense of comfort and sophistication. tw-object-cover

This video features a bright and whimsical scene with a cheerful, fantastical atmosphere. The setting is an outdoor, natural environment, depicting a vibrant green hill under a clear blue sky with soft, wispy clouds. The activity level is static, focusing on a single, charming subject. The visual style is highly artistic and illustrative, reminiscent of a cartoon or children's book, with a touch of photorealism in the textures. The emotional tone is peaceful, joyful, and imaginative. The main subject is an adorable, round house shaped like a donut, complete with pink icing, colorful sprinkles, and a chimney made of stacked donuts, emitting a wisp of smoke. The windows and door are adorned with colorful candies, and warm light glows from within. The color characteristics are predominantly warm and pastel, with high saturation, creating a sweet and inviting palette of blues, greens, pinks, and various candy colors. tw-object-cover

Desktop.notes: Use a strong dark hero background with white text per referenceMap.heroPattern and Techjockey hero bgRule. Include brand/logo at upper left, then headline, subheadline, supporting line, and a single primary CTA. Add the banner feature stack as short bullets: AI Image Generation, AI Video Generation with Audio, Multimodal Content Creation, Enterprise-ready AI infrastructure. No secondary CTA because input is empty. Keep the hero dense but controlled, with clear vertical hierarchy.

Desktop.contentSource: contentMap.extras[BANNER FEATURES] + brand trust system placeholders
Desktop.notes: Trust content is sparse in input, so build a minimal proof bar using the Techjockey trust pattern without inventing customer counts. Use four compact centered pills separated by dividers. Populate with the provided banner feature claims only. Keep background #f8f9fa and use subtle icon treatment if needed.

Desktop.variantHint: 3-column feature grid with introductory text block spanning full width
Desktop.notes: Create a full-width section with a section label, headline, and description at top, followed by feature cards. Use 6 feature cards total, so render as a 3-column grid with 2 rows on desktop. Highlight the first feature as a summary card if helpful, but keep all cards within the same system. No hero imagery; rely on text hierarchy and card structure. CTA should sit below the intro copy as a primary text button or compact solid button in the accent color.

Desktop.variantHint: 3-column feature grid with intro text block; slightly more technical emphasis
Desktop.notes: Render as a matching product section for visual consistency. Since this section has 6 features, use the same 3-column card grid. Keep the intro copy concise and emphasize synchronized audio-visual generation, multilingual lip-sync, cinematic camera control, and 10x faster inference. No CTA provided in input, so omit the button and let the section read as informational compared to Seedream.

Desktop.variantHint: 2-card pricing grid with elevated quote-style cards, not a checkout module
Desktop.notes: Although pricing is partially sparse, it is explicitly supported and should be included. Use two centered pricing cards in a light grey section background. Since only one price is provided and the other is blank, treat this as quote-request pricing rather than transactional pricing. Show included features as checklist items and use a full-width Get Quote CTA on each card. If price is blank, omit numeric emphasis and keep the card quote-led.

Desktop.variantHint: 3-column testimonial cards with accent left border and star rating row
Desktop.notes: Use the provided three meaningful testimonials and exclude the malformed 'T' entry. Build 3 cards on desktop with a gold star rating row, italic quote, bold author name, and grey designation line. Keep the section background very light grey or lightly tinted for separation. If company is blank, omit it rather than inventing one.

Mobile.notes: Stack all hero content vertically. Keep the hero text-led with the same dark treatment and use full-width CTA. Ensure the banner feature stack becomes a short vertical list with compact spacing. Maintain tight line breaks so the long headline remains legible on 390px width. No secondary CTA.
